messages:
lex: Heads-up: embedding response shape changed in the new model bundle. I need a 2-sentence blurb for the release notes, a short SDK migration snippet, and a note about link redirects for older docs pages. Target: tomorrow morning deploy.
sam: I started a PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1309 - added the blurb under /releases/embedding-format and an examples section. PTAL.
eli: Saw it on staging. The vector now wraps with {data: [{embedding: [...] , index: 0}]} instead of top-level list. That breaks a lot of tiny scripts.
eli: Quick example of old vs new in the thread so docs are explicit:
```json
// old (pre-change)
[0.12, -0.03, ...]
// new (post-change)
{"data": [{"embedding": [0.12, -0.03, ...], "index": 0}], "model": "embed-2026-03"}
```
raj: We should recommend an incremental migration path: update SDK to >=0.9.7 which exposes .embeddings_flatten() and add a single-line example for folks using requests and fetch.
lex: Agreed. Keep the code tiny. Sam can you add this snippet under "migration"?
sam: Added this snippet to PR:
```python
# migration: convert new envelope to flattened vector
resp = client.embeddings.create(input="text")
vec = resp.data[0]['embedding']  # or resp.embeddings_flatten() in SDK >=0.9.7
```
sam: Also added a short one-liner known-issue: "Older docs links to /api/embeddings returning top-level arrays will redirect; update clients to parse the envelope."
docs-ci: Preview available: https://deploy-preview-1309--docs.redwood.ai (rendered: /releases/embedding-format) :white_check_mark: Redirects tested for /api/embeddings-old -> /api/embeddings (302)
eli: Can we include a tiny curl example for non-Python users? Some customers still use cURL.
lex: Yes, one-liner please. Sam?
sam: Added curl example to the PR: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"text"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding'
```
raj: FYI I added a note to changelog: (changelog draft) "Embedding responses now include envelope metadata; update clients or use SDK helpers to flatten." Kept it one sentence.
lex: Good. Also flagging that the sample notebooks had hardcoded vector parsing; changed two links and added redirects. Can we check that the anchor links survived the redirect?
docs-ci: Anchor-check passed for changed pages. CI: all checks green.
eli: Tiny nit: add the phrase "backwards-compatible via SDK helper" to the migration section so customers know there's a safe path. I added a one-line suggestion in PR comments.
sam: Added the phrase and pushed.
lex: Can folks react with :shipit: if OK? I plan to merge once docs-ci passes final run and cut the site deploy at 8:00am.
raj: :shipit:
eli: :shipit:
sam: Merging after CI.
docs-ci: Final preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-1309--docs.redwood.ai. Merge done.
lex: Thanks team. I'll add the release bullet to release-notes and ping product for the announcement. Closing thread.
